newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis shoot and wound two Arabs at roadblock.
newsitem.headline: Israelis shoot and wound two Arabs at roadblock.

text.p: Israeli border policemen shot and wounded two Arabs at an Israeli military roadblock between Jerusalem and Bethlehem early on Sunday, Israel Radio said.
Security forces had thrown protective rings around Israeli cities following a deadly suicide bombing in Tel Aviv on Friday and threats of more to come.
Israeli army radio, reporting on the incident, said the two Arabs, travelling in a car, apparently had tried to run the checkpoint between Jerusalem and Bethlehem in the West Bank.
It said they were moderately wounded.
The Moslem militant group Hamas claimed responsibility for killing three Israeli women in Friday's suicide bombing of a Tel Aviv cafe.
On Saturday, Hamas threatened to launch further attacks if building continued for a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
